criteria.criterion: A new module in crates/athena-core builds the labeled set only from introspection records that have a matching person-review record, and keeps the labeler (person or stronger model) on each row.
criteria.evidence: crates/athena-core/src/labeled.rs `build` (lines 157-214) adds a row only when the newest `ClassLabel` names the introspection. Otherwise it counts the introspection as unreviewed. `Row.labeled_by: Labeler` and `RowScore.labeled_by` carry the labeler. `ClassLabel` and `Labeler` (Person, StrongerModel) are new in athena-data records.rs.

criteria.criterion: The scoring module computes the Brier score of Jev's class probability vector against the label, the two references (always 'none', word overlap), skill over the better reference, top-1 accuracy and the false-match rate on 'none' labels, split by time.
criteria.evidence: labeled.rs: `brier` is a multi-class Brier score over the probability map. `score()` computes always_none_brier and overlap_brier (the overlap threshold is set on the calibration part), picks better_reference by lower mean, takes skill as the mean per-record difference, and computes top1_accuracy and false_match_rate on rows whose label is none. `split()` splits by time at `--cut`, or by default leaves the earliest two thirds for calibration; only the test part is scored.

criteria.criterion: The module and command never open a file for writing, and a test asserts it as proposals.rs does.
criteria.evidence: The test `the_scoring_path_never_opens_a_file_for_writing` scans the non-test source of labeled.rs for File::create, OpenOptions, fs::write and similar calls. The command calls `open(false)`, the non-writing open. The CLI test checks that HEAD is unchanged and `git status --porcelain` is empty after the run. My own run of score-jev also left `git status --porcelain` empty.

criteria.criterion: docs/design/defaults-loop.md step 6 is updated to say what was built and what is not (membership, signal match, cluster, prose and cost scoring, and live shadow run), and CHANGELOG.md is updated.
criteria.evidence: Step 6 now has a 'Built (step 6)' paragraph. Its 'Not built' list covers set membership, signal match, cluster assignment, confidence, prose faithfulness, cost and latency, the writer of labels, the live shadow run and promotion. CHANGELOG.md has a matching entry under Added. I checked the doc's claims against the code (MIN_TEST_CASES=10, the newest label counts, the default two-thirds split, the n > (1.96·sd/mean)² rule) and they match.

criteria.evidence: Every test passed. crates/athena-cli/tests/labeled.rs builds a temp git fixture with FakeJev answers produced by the real `ask_jev`. `reviewed_cases_with_fake_jev_answers_give_a_score_a_verdict_and_change_nothing` covers (a), (c) and (d): it asserts n=12, an interval or a 'no bound was computed' note, 7 verdict items, and excluded counts of unreviewed=1, no_jev_answer=1, jev_error=1. `a_few_reviewed_cases_give_no_score_and_no_verdict` and `an_empty_store_reports_too_few_labeled_cases_and_exits_cleanly` cover (b). labeled.rs has matching unit tests.

findings.summary: crates/athena-core/src/store.rs was changed but is not on the expected deliverables list.
findings.evidence: The change adds a `class_labels` field to `Records` and an `AnyRecord::ClassLabel` arm. Without that arm, the existing `other =>` arm would call `job_of(...).expect(...)` on a label record, so the edit is needed for the new record kind. It is still outside the listed scope.

findings.summary: An existing comment in records.rs was damaged by an accidental line join.
findings.evidence: `AnyRecord::DefaultsProposal(p) => p.validate().map_err(invalid)?, // Totals are what reconciliation checks...` The comment that introduced the Outcome arm now trails the DefaultsProposal arm, and its continuation '(acceptance verification 2)' stands alone on the next line. Rustfmt does not reflow comments, so the format check did not catch it.

findings.summary: Two expected deliverables were left unchanged: jev.rs and wiring.rs.
findings.evidence: `git diff HEAD~1 --stat` lists neither file. The command works without them, so nothing is missing.

summary: The change does what was asked, so the verdict is pass with two minor findings. It adds a read-only `athena score-jev [--cut] [--json]` command, backed by a new module, `athena-core/src/labeled.rs`, and a new record kind, `athena.class-label/1`. The command builds the labeled set only from introspections that have a review label and keeps who labeled each one. It scores Jev's stored class answers by Brier score against two baselines, always 'none' and word overlap, and splits the cases by time. It reports skill over the better baseline, top-1 accuracy, the false-match rate on 'none' labels, the sample size, and either a 95% interval or a 'no bound was computed' note, followed by the verdict on items 1 to 3 of section 10.4. Below 10 test cases it says 'too few labeled cases' and gives no score and no verdict. It counts what it leaves out: unreviewed introspections, those with no Jev answer, and failed Jev calls. All the checks I ran pass: `cargo test`, clippy and fmt. `--help` lists the command, and running `score-jev --json` on a store with no records reported 'too few labeled cases', exited cleanly and wrote nothing. The design doc and CHANGELOG match the code. The two minor findings: `store.rs` was changed although it is not on the deliverables list (the change is needed for the new record kind), and an existing comment in `records.rs` was damaged when two lines were joined.
